license: Natural Earth geometry is public domain
attribution: Made with Natural Earth. Country names from WHO Global Health Observatory.

preparation.island_filter: Always preserve the largest polygon of each feature; omit smaller components below threshold
preparation.precision: 3 decimal places, except full precision retained if rounding would produce invalid geometry
preparation.winding: Clockwise exterior rings for D3/Vega spherical rendering
preparation.properties: Only iso3/name for world and state/name for Australia
preparation.join_keys: Exactly one world feature per ISO3; same-code source features merged into one MultiPolygon, retaining their islands

join_coverage.missing_reason: French overseas territories have no separately keyed polygons in this Natural Earth countries file. Retain these observations in non-map charts; do not invent polygons.

notes: Natural Earth uses de facto boundaries; geometry is a generalised illustration, not authoritative boundary advice.

Guadeloupe, French Guiana, Martinique and Reunion lack separate ISO keys in this countries file; some overseas geometry is grouped with France. WHO observations for those territories remain available outside the choropleth.
Australian states are keyed using ISO 3166-2 suffixes, rather than Natural Earth's abbreviated postal fields.
Lord Howe Island is a separate NSW feature; Jervis Bay and Macquarie Island are omitted from this state-level map.
WHO country names include small countries without polygons and should also support non-map displays.
